messages:
leah: Heads-up: we published redwood-community-kits v0.1.0 — a curated set of tiny, reusable templates for integrations + community contribs. :sparkles:

release-bot: Release link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-community-kits/releases/tag/v0.1.0 

omar: Nice! What does the kit include?

leah: Short list: streaming chat template, simple embedding pipeline, and a starter eval harness. Each kit has a one-file example and a LICENSE + CONTRIBUTING note.

devrel: Planning a short online "Maintainers + Contributors" summit next Wednesday to walk through the kits and community contribution flow. 30 min session + Q&A.

omar: I'll demo the embedding pipeline. Can we add a 2-line migration note for existing contributors?

leah: Yep: "If you previously used community-extras, switch imports from community_extras.* to community_kits.*. No behavioral changes otherwise."

ci-bot: CI: tag v0.1.0 build 10234  all checks passed  smoke tests for examples passed.

security: Security note: dependency audit run, no critical findings. We recommend maintainers re-run audits before adding new deps.

devrel: I'll draft the summit invite + community post. Suggested blurb: "redwood-community-kits v0.1.0 — tiny templates to get started faster. Join our maintainer summit Wed to see demos and ask questions."

omar: Small perf note we can include: embedding example uses minibatching and shows ~10% lower end-to-end time on small test data. Include with measurement caveats.

leah: Thanks all. I'll add the calendar invite and the community forum post after DevRel finalizes copy.

devrel: Posting to community channels tomorrow 11am PT. Volunteers for short demos: @omar and @leah.

omar: RSVP'ed. :thumbsup:
